name: baton
description: Baton marketplace: the conductor and refuter orchestrators with their worker packs, and domain skills (Bevy, Rust, TypeScript, Vue3, Blender).

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Conductor worker pack: 4 subagents (planning, research, implement, code-review) for the baton:conductor orchestrator. The orchestrator, the context7 MCP server and the git-diff and okf-memory skills come from the baton dependency. Subagents work through the job-file protocol in .claude/conductor/jobs/<job-id>/; the orchestrator is the only agent that talks to you and keeps the project's .claude/agent-memory/baton-conductor/ Obsidian vault. Run /baton:setup to enable the Task tools (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS) in the project's .claude/settings.json.

plugins.name: refuter
plugins.description: Refuter worker pack: 5 subagents (scout, architect, developer, tester, expert) for the baton:refuter orchestrator. The orchestrator, the context7 MCP server and the git-diff and okf-memory skills come from the baton dependency. Subagents work through the job-file protocol in .claude/refuter/jobs/<job-id>/; the orchestrator is the only agent that talks to you and keeps the project's .claude/agent-memory/baton-refuter/ memory vault. Run /baton:setup to enable the Task tools (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS) in the project's .claude/settings.json.

plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: Shared core and orchestrators for the conductor and refuter worker packs: the baton:conductor and baton:refuter orchestrator agents, context7 MCP server, Task-tools SessionStart hook + /baton:setup, CRLF-restoring PostToolUse hook, git-diff, okf-memory and okf-memory-migrate skills.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Starship-style powerline statusline for Claude Code: repo/branch with live git flags, model + context window usage, and plan usage (5h session / weekly / Fable) with reset countdowns. Run /statusline:setup to wire it into settings.json.

plugins.name: bevy
plugins.description: Bevy 0.19.1 ECS conventions, plugin architecture, and gameplay patterns. Apply when writing or reviewing Bevy game code.

plugins.name: blender
plugins.description: Blender-to-Bevy workflow conventions using bevy_skein 0.6.0. Apply when writing code that integrates with Blender or uses bevy_skein.

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: Rust coding standards and conventions. Apply when writing or reviewing Rust files.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript coding standards. Apply when writing or reviewing TypeScript or TSX files.

plugins.name: vue3
plugins.description: Vue 3 coding standards with Composition API, Pinia, and TypeScript. Apply when writing or reviewing .vue files and Vue-related composables.
